meta.title: Hot Wheels Tooned — variants database for collector app

scope.dedicated_castings: All documented physical releases/production variants found for dedicated Tooned castings in the researched catalog snapshot.
scope.official_segment_members: For non-dedicated castings, only Tooned-branded/Tooned-pack releases are included, so unrelated histories of those castings do not pollute the Tooned checklist.
scope.2014_2015: Stored separately because 'Tooned' was used as a segment label for entertainment/cartoon vehicles and does not always imply the classic exaggerated body style.
scope.related_2004_styles: Fatbax, Hardnoze, Blings and Crooze are included as family taxonomy/casting lists; their full color histories are intentionally not mixed into the Tooned checklist.
scope.packaging: Long card/short card/international packaging alone does not create a vehicle variant. Packaging-only differences should be tracked separately if the app later needs them.

variant_policy.production_variant: Physical change in the miniature within a release (wheel/base/tampo/etc.).
variant_policy.id_rule: Stable unique variant ID. Use casting_id to group all versions of the same mold.

review_queue.name: Tooned '59 Chevy
review_queue.reason: A specialist casting index labels a 'Tooned ’59 Chevy' debuting in 2004, while period year indexes prominently associate the exaggerated '59 Chevy with Hardnoze. Kept out of primary data until casting identity is reconciled.

review_queue.action: Do not show in default checklist until casting/base identity is verified.
